summary: The ChatGPT APK is the official Android app for OpenAI's ChatGPT assistant, for chatting, writing, voice conversations, image creation and answering questions with web search. The latest version is 1.2026.321, updated November 22, 2026, and needs Android 7.1 or newer. It's free to use, with paid plans for more.
metaDescription: ChatGPT APK download for Android: get the official OpenAI app, version 1.2026.321, with install steps, free vs paid plans, privacy tips and fixes.

faq.q: Is the ChatGPT app free on Android?
faq.a: Yes. You can use ChatGPT for free with usage limits. Paid plans, sold in the app, raise limits and unlock OpenAI's most capable models and extra features.

faq.q: Is ChatGPT safe for confidential information?
faq.a: Don't paste passwords, ID numbers, medical records or confidential work documents. Chats may be used to improve OpenAI's models unless you turn that off in Settings → Data controls, and Temporary Chat keeps a conversation out of your history.
OpenAI requires users to be at least 13, with parental consent for under-18s. Google Play rates the app Teen. Parents can link a teen's account to set controls such as quiet hours.
Check your connection, update the app from Google Play, and log out and back in. If it's slow or failing for everyone, OpenAI's servers may be busy; status.openai.com shows outages.

faq.q: ChatGPT vs Gemini: which is better on Android?
faq.a: Gemini works with your Gmail, Calendar and other Google apps and can replace Google Assistant. ChatGPT is stronger for open-ended writing and has a large set of custom GPTs. Many people use both.
